sanskrit_verse:
सर्वालापं तु यः कृत्वा मिथो 'ल्पम् अपि संवदेत् ।
सर्वम् एव तु दाप्यः स्याद् अभियुक्तो बृहस्पतिः ॥
transliteration: sarvālāpaṃ tu yaḥ kṛtvā mitho 'lpam api saṃvadet | sarvam eva tu dāpyaḥ syād abhiyukto bṛhaspatiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who engages in mutual discourse after initiating universal speech shall restore all that was spoken, as enjoined by Brihaspati.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the completeness of expression
Causation arises through initiation of communicative action
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to volitional engagement
Restoration logic requires reversal of energetic discharge
Consciousness alignment occurs via reabsorption of misdirected intent
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent initiates universal speech THEN agent assumes full restorative liability FOR all consequent mutual discourse
IF communicative act is executed THEN energetic accountability MUST be reversed through completion protocol
IF abhiyukta status is established THEN all effects of speech SHALL be re-integrated by originator
IF causal chain begins with speaker THEN capacity for restoration IS binding irrespective of magnitude
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, any party initiating public or universal declarations becomes ipso facto responsible for restoring integrity to all responsive dialogue generated thereby. The threshold of responsibility is not intent but initiation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that speech generates energetic causality. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces this sequence back to its originator. Responsibility aligns proportionally with capacity to initiate rather than suffer consequence. This reflects Nyaya's non-punitive basis: correction through conscious reintegration, not imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pratyāhāra process to withdraw dispersed linguistic energy
Enforce śabda-saṃskāra purification through mantra-based restitution
Execute vyavahāra-bandhana dissolution through reciprocal truth alignment
Reintegrate causal speaker into akhaṇḍa-vāk utterance state
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Speech binds the speaker to total restoration. Dharma prevails through consciousness realignment. Reality remains ever non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the final arbiter.
